purpose: Phase 1 browser wishlist state shared across storefront pages until authenticated wishlist APIs are integrated.
businessRules: Persist only product IDs in browser storage.
Product names, prices, SKU, category, and images must be resolved from backend storefront product data before rendering.
Wishlist viewing remains public in Phase 1; future account persistence can merge browser IDs after login.
Invalid persisted wishlist values must be ignored and duplicate product IDs must be merged.
